integrity: Reproducible symbolic and exact-rational checker included. Self-review only; independent scientific and historical-priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires strictly positive common-denominator crowding and two-stage, three-season matrices; excludes stochasticity, stage-specific density responses and constrained seasonal feasibility. Spectral ranking is not ranking of equilibrium abundance.
title: A three-season orientation criterion for global persistence of saturated two-stage populations
